mainEntity.name: How do I create a realistic budget for my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creating a realistic budget involves researching average costs for similar projects in your area, obtaining detailed quotes from contractors, and allocating a contingency fund. Start by defining your project's scope, then gather at least three itemized bids to compare. It's wise to set aside 10-20% of your total budget for unexpected expenses that often arise during remodeling, like structural repairs or upgraded permits. We recommend discussing your financial parameters early with our team to ensure your project goals align with your budget from the outset.
